permission: User-authorized extraction from selected watercolor master
implementation: Three world-anchored 2.5D painted panels, registered to the original forty-step board. Native 35-degree camera, slot coordinates, landing hooks and gameplay retained. Tile side thickness scaled to 42%, top heights retained; existing Sanguo corner aliases retained.

cast.poses: Four characters, front/back artwork; main player uses two poses with mirroring, sway and bounce. NPCs use one front pose each with procedural pacing/breathing.
cast.runtimeEncoding: Lossless WebP, exact RGBA equality verified

overview.cameraBounds: Derived from the three painted panels and the full 750x1624 canvas; shared by following, panning and event views.

limitations: Scenery uses flat painted world panels, not separately modeled buildings; residents use independent animated RGBA sprites with timed market visits and home routines.
Original 40-step loop occupies the central painted 10x10 lot; gameplay was not changed to 100 steps.
Painterly perspective and native camera differ slightly; the panels use independent horizontal/vertical registration scales.
Original artwork was 1024x1536; the HD replacement is 2048x3072 assembled from four separately generated 1024x1536 quadrants, without resizing.
Outside the original frame, manual panning shows a paving extension, not additional authored scenery.
This is a three-pass approximation, not a pixel-identical reconstruction.
runtimePanelEncoding: Lossless WebP; decoded RGBA pixels verified identical to extracted PNGs.

characters.vendors: Four counter-occluded original silhouettes retain their original occlusion; implied full-body reference used.

animation.cycles: Four shopper positions arrive, buy, leave, wait, then change among three identities. Four sellers serve or arrange goods. Sweeper works 18s, goes home 5s, rests 14s, comes out 5s.
animation.occlusion: Source-clean-v3 counters reused as foreground occluders; original house door animates open; resident sprites never bake into scene panels.

hdScene.method: Four 512x768 input quadrants independently restored at 1024x1536 and assembled without resizing.
